units.text: INT. BOWLING ALLEY OFFICE - DAY
An open-plan office built into a defunct bowling alley.
Desks sit on the lanes.
Monitors glow where the pins used to stand.
A scoreboard overhead reads "SYNERGY: 0."
BRANDYN HOLLIS, forties, a regional vice president in a vest with a lanyard, stands at lane three, clapping.
CHIDI OBI, thirties, an analyst with tired eyes, sits at lane four.
MARGUERITE FENN, fifties, head of compliance, in a cardigan, clutches a binder.
DEV PATEL-ROSS, twenties, an intern, kneels on lane two plugging in a power strip.
UNDERWOOD, sixties, the janitor, mops the gutter without comment.
Team! We are pivoting to a bowling-first culture.
units.name: BRANDYN

units.text: Pivot to what? We have no pins.
units.name: CHIDI

units.text: Exactly. Pins are legacy.
units.name: BRANDYN

units.text: Brandyn, the fire marshal says the lanes are not rated for desks.
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: Marguerite, the lanes are a metaphor.
units.name: BRANDYN

units.text: There's a ball in my power strip.
units.name: DEV

units.text: The ball returns are still live.
units.name: CHIDI

units.text: Great. Let's leverage the returns. Everyone grab a ball and a quarterly goal.
units.name: BRANDYN

units.text: That is a safety violation.
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: It is a culture violation not to.
units.name: BRANDYN

units.text: Brandyn, I haven't been paid since the third frame.
units.name: CHIDI

units.text: Strike, Chidi. We're all in a gutter right now.
units.name: BRANDYN

units.text: A ball rolls down lane two and takes out Dev's power strip.
The monitors go dark.
The scoreboard flickers: "SYNERGY: 1."
Told you.
units.name: UNDERWOOD
